description.en: Sets the draw/visibility state of a named telop caption created with CMND_2DO_CREATE_TELOP.
Name of the telop to update.
True once it succeeded; false if the named telop isn't ready/found; null if the call itself was invalid (too few arguments).

example.code:
// Update a telop caption's draw state
CMND_2DO_STATE_DRAW_TELOP(_name, _pro_data[1]);
